description: Return one category of b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard: every curated domain ranked by overall readiness score (0–100) with its letter grade and AEO score, as scanned weekly by the same rule-based scanner as scan_site. Unscanned domains sort last with null scores. Use list_leaderboard_categories for the slugs.

limit.description: How many rows to return, from the top. Default 15 (a full category).

name: get_leaderboard
title: Get a leaderboard category
